text.arabic_uthmani: قُلْ مَن كَانَ فِى ٱلضَّلَٰلَةِ فَلْيَمْدُدْ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ مَدًّا ۚ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ إِمَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ وَإِمَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ شَرٌّۭ مَّكَانًۭا وَأَضْعَفُ جُندًۭا

words.gloss_range: imperative reporting command that frames the entire following threat as commissioned speech
words.root_gloss_range: speech-command root field as tagged in the bundle; local surface selects the imperative saying command
words.prose: {{ar:قُلْ}} ({{tr:qul}}) puts the whole ayah under a commissioned speech frame. The conditional premise, the extension, the terminal seeing, and the final verdict all arrive as a divine answer voiced by the Prophet, with the future-knowing threat linked to public challenge formulas including 20:135 and to the immediate challenge-response setting of 19:73.

topics.headline: commanded rebuttal frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the whole warning is not neutral narration but a commanded prophetic answer to the challenge.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark the surface as a second-person masculine singular imperative governing the full quoted utterance, so the CRITICAL command-frame and challenge-response rows are locally supported.

words.gloss_range: indefinite conditional pronoun, singular in form but universal in conditional scope
words.prose: {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}) opens the protasis as whoever is in error: singular on the surface, but broad enough to cover the whole class that later sees and knows in the plural. The repeated pronoun near the end turns this opening liability into disclosed identity, so the ayah moves from whoever is in error to who is worse.

topics.headline: universal conditional opener
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a singular whoever opening that can later widen into plural seeing and knowing without grammatical tension.
topics.reason: QAC makes the word the conditional subject of the protasis and attachment links that protasis to the later apodosis; the singular-to-plural and repeated-pronoun CRITICAL payoffs therefore survive.

words.gloss_range: past copula in a conditional frame, marking a settled or habitual state with a prepositional predicate
words.root_gloss_range: being and becoming root field; local use is copular rather than lexical action
words.prose: {{ar:كَانَ}} ({{tr:kana}}) makes error a settled condition inside the conditional frame. It links the subject to a prepositional predicate rather than taking error as a direct object, so the ayah begins with someone already situated in misguidance and later converts that being-state into a station verdict, with local echoes to 19:44, 19:61, and 17:72 kept as contextual pressure.

topics.headline: settled being in error
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the extension responds to an already inhabited state, not to a one-off past act.
topics.reason: The guardrail grammar identifies a past copula with conditional force and a governed prepositional complement, supporting the CRITICAL rows about habitual state, being-location, and the later station echo.

words.gloss_range: locative preposition governing the error noun as an inhabited domain
words.prose: {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fi}}) turns error into an environment: the person is in misguidance, not merely labeled by it. That containment image completes the condition before the apodosis and prepares the later place-and-station language of the verdict.

topics.headline: error as containment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader pictures misguidance as a space occupied from within, preparing the later judgment of station.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence force the prepositional government of the error noun, so the CRITICAL containment and prepositional-predicate rows are locally licensed.

words.gloss_range: definite verbal noun for the known domain or condition of misguidance
words.root_gloss_range: straying, losing the way, and misguidance root field; local form selects the abstract inhabited condition
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلضَّلَٰلَةِ}} ({{tr:al-dalalati}}) names the recognizable domain of misguidance as a verbal noun under the in-phrase. Its payoff is both lexical and structural: the root image of being lost becomes an inhabited condition, and that condition moves toward punishment, forced knowledge, and the worse-place verdict, with 17:72 and 25:34 functioning as concrete parallels rather than replacements for the local sense.

topics.headline: inhabited misguidance condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees misguidance as a recognized condition being prolonged toward exposure, not as a small isolated mistake.
topics.reason: The word is a definite gerund governed by the preposition and serving the copular predicate, which supports the CRITICAL claims about settled lostness, the absence of guidance, and movement toward exposure.

words.gloss_range: causal or sequential apodosis connector after the conditional premise
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) is the hinge from the condition to the response. It keeps the extension from sounding like an unrelated sentence: whoever is in error, then the decree of extension follows.

topics.headline: premise-to-extension hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the state of error is routed directly into the decree of extension.
topics.reason: The clause evidence marks the following segment as the conditional apodosis, so the CRITICAL rows about direct linkage are supported.

words.gloss_range: command lam governing the jussive imperfect that follows
words.prose: {{ar:لْ}} ({{tr:l}}) supplies the command force before the jussive verb. Because the subject is the All-Merciful, the construction functions as a decree of what God grants, not as a human command addressed to God.

topics.headline: jussive decree particle
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears command force built through a particle, making the extension a threatening divine ordinance.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify command lam governing the jussive extension verb; this supports the CRITICAL command-without-imperative and threat-decree payoffs.

words.gloss_range: jussive extension verb with recipient phrase and cognate accusative, leaving the extended object compressed
words.root_gloss_range: extension, stretching, prolonging, and supplying root field; local use selects ominous prolongation in the decree frame
words.prose: {{ar:يَمْدُدْ}} ({{tr:yamdud}}) makes the response an act of extension: the recipient is named, the explicit object is compressed, and the cognate noun after it intensifies the same root. The extension feels like granted time, but nearby 19:79 and the endpoint introduced by until make the prolongation ominous rather than simple favor.

topics.headline: ominous extension decree
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that respite is stretched for the erring person until a fixed endpoint, with the object compressed and the irony left tense.
topics.reason: The verb is jussive, governed by command lam, has the All-Merciful as subject, a benefactive complement, and a cognate accusative; this supports the extension, irony, and same-surah threat rows.

words.gloss_range: benefactive preposition plus singular pronoun resuming the conditional subject
words.root_gloss_range: bundle-aligned root is not semantically active as a lexical root here; local function is preposition plus pronoun
words.prose: {{ar:لَهُ}} ({{tr:lahu}}) resumes the singular whoever as the recipient of extension. The for-him grammar sounds benefactive, yet the ayah later reveals that the granted interval leads to seeing, knowing, and judgment; the recipient is foregrounded before the divine subject is named.

topics.headline: benefactive recipient irony
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the irony that the extension is grammatically for him while the sequence ends in exposure.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the suffix as the benefactive complement of the extension verb, and QAC marks the singular pronoun; this supports the CRITICAL irony and referent-continuity rows while limiting the listed root to alignment metadata.

words.gloss_range: definite divine name as delayed nominative subject of the extension verb
words.root_gloss_range: mercy, compassion, and divine forbearance root field; local use is the proper divine name governing ominous respite
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ}} ({{tr:al-rahmanu}}) arrives after the recipient phrase as the explicit subject of the extension. That delay matters: the one in error does not control the extension, and the mercy-name governs a reprieve that can end in punishment or the Hour, echoing Maryam’s dense mercy-name thread at 19:44, 19:45, and 19:61.

topics.headline: mercy-name as subject of delay
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the ominous extension is still under the divine name of mercy, making delay forbearance rather than neglect.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment identify the word as the nominative subject of the extension verb; the CRITICAL rows about mercy, reprieve, and same-surah divine-name recurrence are coherent with that local grammar.

words.gloss_range: indefinite cognate accusative intensifying and measuring the extension
words.root_gloss_range: extension and prolongation root field; local noun is the internal object of the same-root verb
words.prose: {{ar:مَدًّا}} ({{tr:maddan}}) is the cognate accusative that turns the verb’s extension into emphatic prolongation. The repeated root and doubled sound make the delay feel stretched, while the historical warning from 19:74 and the same-root punishment extension in 19:79 keep that stretch under threat.

topics.headline: intensified stretch of delay
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears and sees the delay thickened by a verb-plus-verbal-noun pairing rather than a bare statement of extension.
topics.reason: The noun is grammatically marked as a cognate accusative of the extension verb, so the CRITICAL rows about intensification, sound, rarity, and threat-weight are locally supported.

words.gloss_range: terminative particle introducing the endpoint clause of the extension
words.prose: {{ar:حَتَّىٰٓ}} ({{tr:hatta}}) cuts the open-ended feeling of extension by introducing its endpoint. The delay lasts only until the promised reality is seen, so the ayah divides into present prolongation and terminal disclosure.

topics.headline: bounded respite endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the extension is not endless; it is held only until a certain seeing event.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence links the temporal clause to the extension verb and QAC marks a terminative particle, supporting the CRITICAL rows about bounded respite and the future-prospect boundary.

words.gloss_range: temporal conditional of certain arrival introducing the seeing event
words.prose: {{ar:إِذَا}} ({{tr:idha}}) makes the endpoint a certain when-clause. It waits for the answer in the future-knowledge clause and removes the possibility that the promised seeing is merely hypothetical.

topics.headline: certain when of disclosure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the terminal event as when it happens, not whether it happens.
topics.reason: QAC describes the particle as a temporal conditional implying certainty, and the clause evidence identifies the terminal seeing clause; the CRITICAL certainty rows are therefore supported.

words.gloss_range: perfect verb inside a certain temporal clause, pluralizing the earlier singular whoever into collective witness
words.root_gloss_range: seeing, perceiving, and realizing root field; local use is direct eschatological sight
words.prose: {{ar:رَأَوْا۟}} ({{tr:raaw}}) is a plural perfect verb inside the certain when-clause, presenting the future sight as already assured. The singular whoever has become a witnessing crowd, and that sight forces the knowledge that follows; parallels such as 46:35 and the punishment-seeing pattern in 10:88 and 26:201 sharpen the warning frame.

topics.headline: future certainty as compelled sight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the future event is spoken with past-form certainty and that individual liability becomes collective witness.
topics.reason: QAC marks a third-person masculine plural perfect verb in the temporal clause, with the following relative object attached; this supports the CRITICAL rows about rhetorical past, plural shift, and compelled sight.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun holding the promised object before later appositional specification
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:ma}}) bridges seeing to the passive promise: what they see is what they were promised. The word withholds the content until the either-or pair specifies it as punishment or the Hour, so the grammar performs a short delay before disclosure.

topics.headline: deferred promised object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader experiences a brief withholding before punishment and the Hour name what is seen.
topics.reason: Attachment marks the word as object of seeing and retained object of the passive promise verb, with later appositional alternatives; this supports the CRITICAL suspense and bridge rows.

words.gloss_range: passive imperfect promise verb with plural subject and retained object
words.root_gloss_range: promise, threat, and appointed fulfillment root field; local passive selects threatened fulfillment
words.prose: {{ar:يُوعَدُونَ}} ({{tr:yuaduna}}) makes the promised thing a passive warning fact: the promiser is not named on the surface, while the object is carried by the relative pronoun and then specified by the alternatives. The sequence promise, sight, knowledge turns Maryam’s wider promise field toward threat, with 72:24 and 19:61 as important contrasts.

topics.headline: passive promised threat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees promise-language inverted into warning fulfillment, with the promiser unspoken because the promised reality itself is now decisive.
topics.reason: QAC marks a passive imperfect plural verb and attachment treats the relative pronoun as its retained object; this supports the CRITICAL rows about passive inevitability, warning fulfillment, and the promise-to-knowledge sequence.

words.gloss_range: first member of a correlative either-or pair specifying the promised object
words.prose: {{ar:إِمَّا}} ({{tr:imma}}) opens the disjunctive pair that specifies what they are promised to see. The grammar does not open a relief option; it begins a closed set of catastrophic endpoints.

topics.headline: first catastrophic alternative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the promised object is narrowed into a closed pair whose first option is already judgment.
topics.reason: Attachment and translation support treat the either-or pair as a construction specifying the relative object, supporting the CRITICAL closed-alternative rows.

words.gloss_range: definite accusative punishment as the first appositional specification of the promised object
words.root_gloss_range: punishment and painful deprivation root field; local use selects the judgment-punishment branch
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْعَذَابَ}} ({{tr:al-adhaba}}) names the first concrete specification of what will be seen. Once punishment appears, the earlier extension is heard as reprieve under mercy that terminates in judgment, and the same-surah link to 19:79 makes that threat heavier.

topics.headline: punishment as endpoint of extension
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the earlier extension reinterpreted as respite moving toward punishment.
topics.reason: The word is definite accusative and appositional to the promised object, while local sequence links extension to the punishment alternative; this supports the CRITICAL punishment, mercy-judgment, and 19:79 rows.

words.gloss_range: conjunction functioning inside the correlative either-or construction
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) works within the either-or construction, marking the second member rather than simply adding an unrelated item. It keeps punishment and the Hour balanced under the single promised object.

topics.headline: balanced second alternative marker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader does not read the next endpoint as a loose addition; it is the coordinated second option in the same closed disjunction.
topics.reason: The guardrail construction evidence treats the pair as parallel appositions, so the CRITICAL rows about non-additive disjunction and balanced closure are supported.

words.gloss_range: second member completing the correlative either-or pair
words.prose: {{ar:إِمَّا}} ({{tr:imma}}) completes the correlative pair and gives the Hour equal grammatical weight with punishment. The structure closes the promised future into two non-relief endpoints, with 19:79 sharpening the punishment-extension logic nearby.

topics.headline: completed disjunctive pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the Hour kept parallel to punishment, with no third outcome left open.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the second member of the parallel appositional construction; this supports the CRITICAL symmetry, exhaustiveness, and nearby fulfillment rows.

words.gloss_range: definite technical term for the Hour as the second promised endpoint
words.root_gloss_range: time, hour, and sudden decisive moment root field; local use selects the eschatological Hour
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلسَّاعَةَ}} ({{tr:al-saata}}) names the second endpoint as the definite Hour, not an ordinary time-span. It stands beside punishment as an appositional alternative, closing the stretch of respite with decisive disclosure; parallels such as 6:40 and the Hour-knowledge passages at 7:187, 31:34, and 33:63 add provenance without displacing the local pair.

topics.headline: the Hour as sudden closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees open-ended delay bounded by a definite eschatological moment of disclosure.
topics.reason: The word is a definite accusative apposition under the promised object and QAC identifies it as the Quranic technical term for the Day of Resurrection, supporting the CRITICAL Hour, suddenness, and knowledge-field rows.

words.gloss_range: consecutive result particle introducing the answer to the temporal condition
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) turns the seeing clause into its consequence: when they see, then they will know. Joined with the future marker on the following verb, it makes the cognition an assured result rather than a detached future fact.

topics.headline: seeing-to-knowing hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that knowledge follows directly from the sight event.
topics.reason: Attachment marks the following clause as the result of the temporal condition, and QAC marks this particle as consecutive; this supports the CRITICAL fa-sa consequence rows.

words.gloss_range: future-marked plural imperfect of knowing, giving assured evaluative recognition after sight
words.root_gloss_range: knowing, recognizing, and understanding root field; local use selects compelled evaluative knowledge
words.prose: {{ar:سَيَعْلَمُونَ}} ({{tr:sayaʿlamuna}}) places knowledge after the promised sight and marks it as certain. The content of that knowledge is evaluative: who is worse and weaker, so the earlier status challenge is settled by witnessed reality rather than by argument, with warning-formula parallels at 20:135, 11:39, and 11:93.

topics.headline: forced future recognition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees knowledge arrive as compelled recognition that overturns the earlier boast, not as neutral information.
topics.reason: QAC marks a future-marked plural imperfect with a clausal complement, and attachment links it as the result of seeing; this supports the CRITICAL rows about certainty, eschatological epistemology, and warning formulae.

words.gloss_range: second pronoun introducing the embedded indirect question governed by knowing
words.prose: {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}) heads the indirect question that they will know. It echoes the opening whoever but now withholds the verdict target until the predicate lands, answering the earlier which-party challenge from 19:73 by forcing the comparison into the grammar.

topics.headline: verdict-question pronoun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the opening whoever turn into the final who whose identity is exposed by the verdict.
topics.reason: Attachment makes the word the head of the clausal complement of knowing, and QAC notes its parallel to the opening conditional pronoun; this supports the CRITICAL bracketing, withholding, and implied-comparator rows.

words.gloss_range: separated pronoun emphasizing the judged identity before the comparative predicate
words.prose: {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) isolates the judged identity before the comparative predicate. The separated pronoun gives emphasis and a small delay, so the verdict lands deliberately rather than as a flat category label.

topics.headline: emphatic judged identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels a brief syntactic beat before the comparative verdict identifies the disgraced subject.
topics.reason: QAC marks a separated pronoun and attachment identifies the following comparative as its predicate; this supports the CRITICAL emphasis, identity-isolation, and delay rows.

words.gloss_range: comparative predicate meaning worse, with the respect specified by the following accusative
words.root_gloss_range: bundle-aligned root field; local surface functions as an elative comparative for worse, not as a sale-related lexical branch
words.prose: {{ar:شَرٌّ}} ({{tr:sharrun}}) is the comparative predicate that reverses the earlier claim of being better in station (19:73). The comparator is not named because the debate context supplies it, and the following specification makes the worse-ness a station verdict; 25:34 and 5:60 support the judgment-formula background.

topics.headline: worse-status reversal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the earlier better-status boast answered by an opposite comparative verdict.
topics.reason: The guardrails mark the word as the predicate of the separated pronoun and as specified by the following accusative, supporting the CRITICAL rows about comparative reversal, implicit comparator, and judgment formula.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative of specification naming the domain of worse-ness as place, rank, or station
words.root_gloss_range: being and place root field; local noun-of-place form specifies station rather than a mere physical coordinate
words.prose: {{ar:مَّكَانًا}} ({{tr:makanan}}) specifies worse in what respect: place, rank, or station. Its indefinite accusative form opens the domain rather than naming one literal location, and it mirrors the earlier boast of better standing in 19:73 while echoing the ayah’s opening being-language.

topics.headline: station specified as place
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verdict is worse in the domain of standing or position, answering the earlier station boast.
topics.reason: Attachment identifies the word as the accusative specification for the comparative predicate, and QAC marks a noun of time or place; this supports the CRITICAL station, place-image, and k-w-n echo rows.

words.gloss_range: conjunction joining the two comparative predicate-plus-specification units
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) joins two parallel verdict units: worse in station and weaker in forces. The conjunction makes the reversal complete across both axes of the opponents’ boast, with comparative plus specification balanced on each side.

topics.headline: double verdict connector
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final judgment as two coordinated axes, status and force, rather than a single loose afterthought.
topics.reason: Attachment marks the second comparative as conjoined to the first, and QAC identifies the conjunction; this supports the CRITICAL double-verdict and parallelism rows.

words.gloss_range: second elative comparative, weaker, parallel to the earlier worse predicate
words.root_gloss_range: weakness, doubling, and vulnerability root field; local form selects ranked weakness
words.prose: {{ar:أَضْعَفُ}} ({{tr:adʿafu}}) supplies the second comparative and mirrors the earlier worse predicate. It turns the opponents’ claim of stronger assembly from 19:73 into a weakness verdict, with 72:24 giving a close promised-sight and weaker-language parallel.

topics.headline: weaker-force reversal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees apparent social strength recast as ranked weakness under judgment.
topics.reason: QAC identifies an elative comparative and attachment conjoins it to the first predicate while giving it its own accusative specification; this supports the CRITICAL rows about formal parallelism, social-force reversal, and warning parallels.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative specification naming the domain of weakness as forces, host, or organized support
words.root_gloss_range: troop, host, and organized force root field; local use selects collective backing under comparison
words.prose: {{ar:جُندًا}} ({{tr:jundan}}) is the final specification: weaker in forces, host, or organized support. Its final position leaves the ayah on strength revealed as weakness, answers the assembly boast of 19:73, and lets wider force contrasts such as 33:9, 28:6, 28:8, and 28:40 stand as provenance for fragile human backing under divine command.

topics.headline: forces exposed as weak
topics.reader_payoff: The reader leaves the ayah on the collapse of organized backing, the final answer to the opponents’ social-power claim.
topics.reason: Attachment identifies the word as the accusative specification of the weaker comparative, and QAC marks an indefinite noun of collective force; this supports the CRITICAL rows about force-domain narrowing, final-word closure, and human-versus-divine force contrasts.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The misguidance state, doubled extension construction, until-clause, seeing verb, and threatened objects form one temporal sequence.
baseline_models.mechanism: A person already situated in misguidance receives added duration, but the extension is bounded by direct perception of the threatened outcome. Delay therefore becomes an interval of exposure rather than cancellation.

activation_trace.role: Deviation from guidance supplies the continuing state into which the extension is inserted.
Prolonged term or deadline makes the repeated extension wording a bounded span of time.
Sensory or inward seeing marks the point at which deferred threat becomes disclosed reality.
The threatening side of promise identifies what terminates the apparent open-ended delay.

changed_reading.before: The Merciful merely postpones punishment for someone in error.
changed_reading.after: The postponement is a finite exposure interval: misguidance continues only until its threatened reality becomes directly perceptible.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The final knowledge clause compares place or standing and the effective strength of a supporting collective.
baseline_models.mechanism: Disclosure triggers a counter-ranking of two apparent assets: established position and organized backing. The comparison tests not display or headcount but where each side actually stands and whether its coalition can support it.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge as disclosure turns the closing comparison into a verdict learned after concealment ends.
Badness supplies the adverse axis on which the two positions are reranked.
Place and rank derived from situated being make location also a claim about standing.
Lack of strength supplies the criterion by which apparent collective power fails.
A mutually supporting host makes the final weakness social and operational, not merely personal.

changed_reading.before: They will eventually learn which party is generally worse off.
changed_reading.after: The promised disclosure audits social position and organized support, exposing the apparently established side as worse placed and less effective as a coalition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier sequence turns misguidance from a static label into a reproducible process: loss is followed by pursuit, renewed appetite, and encounter with deviation. Added time can therefore host a feedback loop that keeps generating the state it prolongs.

activation_trace.role: Connected augmentation supplies the extra capacity in which the earlier behavioral sequence can continue.
Loss or letting something go supplies the initiating deprivation in the drift sequence.
Following in another's track converts appetite into a directional practice.
Desire renewed after desire gives the practice a repeatable feedback mechanism.
Dark deviation from sound direction supplies the encountered product of that repeated pursuit.

structural_cues: 19:59 orders relinquishment, following, recurring appetite, and encounter before 19:75 names extension within misguidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: 19:59 supplies an ordered behavioral chain and 19:75 supplies added duration. Inference: duration gives the chain room to recur and compound. Live alternative: 19:59 may list acts and outcome without asserting a feedback loop.

changed_reading.before: Misguidance is a fixed condition prolonged from outside.
changed_reading.after: The extension can enlarge the operating time of a self-renewing drift, so external allowance and internally repeated pursuit jointly sustain the condition.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gathering, enforced proximity, encirclement, arrival, and binding determination turn the focus interval into an approach trajectory. Seeing is the terminal phase of staged placement, not a detached glimpse after neutral waiting.

activation_trace.role: Extended term supplies the duration across which the approach can unfold.
Mutual facing or confrontation makes eventual seeing a forced encounter rather than remote observation.
Driving and collecting a group toward a destination supplies directed movement.
Presence, witnessing, and nearness supply the arrival into exposed proximity.
Position around an object supplies spatial containment at the destination.
Coming upon or reaching something supplies the transition from approach to contact.
A firmly binding determination closes off the reading of extension as indefinite escape.

structural_cues: 19:68 stages collection and surrounding; 19:71 marks arrival as binding; 19:72 then separates rescue from those left in place.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: the context supplies a spatial sequence and a binding endpoint. Inference: the focus extension carries its subject along that approach until seeing occurs. Live alternative: the context may describe the endpoint while the extension itself remains simple delay.

changed_reading.before: The subject waits and then happens to witness the promised event.
changed_reading.after: The extended interval is a directed approach toward enforced presence, with sight arising when gathering, surrounding, and arrival reach their fixed endpoint.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding boasts combine superior station, superior assembly, dense possessions, and attractive appearance. The focus comparison answers in the same domains but changes the metric from visible display and gathering to actual placement and effective support under disclosure.

activation_trace.role: Situated place or rank supplies the focus term that remeasures the earlier claim to superior station.
Deficiency of force replaces visible abundance with an efficacy test.
A supporting collective supplies the focus counterpart to the earlier public assembly.
Residence or established station supplies the boast that the focus later reranks as actual place.
A gathered council supplies visible social backing whose effectiveness is later questioned.
Density and abundance supply the material display that can be mistaken for durable strength.
Outward view or appearance supplies the visual criterion overturned when the threatened event is seen.

structural_cues: 19:73 compares station and assembly, 19:74 adds possessions and appearance, and 19:75 counters with place and collective weakness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: adjacent verses supply repeated comparatives across station, assembly, abundance, appearance, place, and host. Inference: 19:75 directly audits the preceding boast by changing its metric. Live alternative: the closing comparison could be a broader warning rather than a point-by-point answer.

changed_reading.before: The final comparison is a generic reversal of fortune.
changed_reading.after: It is a targeted audit of social capital: impressive venue, assembly, possessions, and appearance do not establish sound placement or a coalition able to help.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following ayah pairs growth with guidance, endurance with sound action, and recompense with return. Beside that pattern, extension within misguidance reads as the adverse side of directional continuation: each orientation is carried forward, but only one yields enduring return.

activation_trace.role: Deviation from sound direction identifies the adverse orientation that receives continuation.
Connected increase or reinforcement lets extension be compared functionally with the following increase.
Merciful tenderness names the administrator of the interval, preventing continuation from being read as endorsement.
Growth and increase supply the explicit positive counterpart to extension.
Gentle direction toward a sound path identifies the orientation amplified on the positive side.
Persistence supplies the durability test that distinguishes useful increase from mere prolongation.
Recompense returning to the actor supplies the yield produced by a trajectory.
Return to a place or state makes final outcome the destination against which continuation is judged.

structural_cues: 19:75 extends a person within misguidance; 19:76 immediately increases the guided within guidance and evaluates what endures and returns.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: the adjacent clauses supply parallel continuation language with opposed orientations and different yields. Inference: they form a polarized law of trajectory amplification. Live alternative: the parallel may be rhetorical contrast without a shared causal rule.

changed_reading.before: Extension in misguidance is an isolated punitive delay.
changed_reading.after: It is the adverse member of a paired continuation pattern: direction is carried forward, while endurance and returned yield reveal the difference between prolongation and growth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the surface promise root is form-distant from counting, but the packet explicitly maps that focus occurrence to the counting inventory and the surrounding extension and endpoint keep the activation anchored. Render it only as a counted-time overlay, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The promised object stands between an extended term and the eventual endpoint.

activation_trace.role: Enumeration turns the promised outcome into something whose approach can be reckoned.
Recurring count of time supplies a countdown-like temporal texture to the promise.
An extended deadline provides the span across which the reckoning continues.

changed_reading.before: The threat is verbally promised while its timing remains an unspecified delay.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory overlay, the promise behaves like a running count: added time lengthens the interval without stopping the approach of its reckoned endpoint.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The doubling branch sits paradoxically under a surface comparative of weakness, so it must not replace the ordinary weakness sense. It remains valid as an activation because the mapped focus branch meets the preceding images of dense possessions and assembly; render it as a quantity-versus-efficacy paradox.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The weakness comparative directly modifies the supporting host after context has foregrounded abundance and assembly.

activation_trace.role: Increase by a like amount activates the paradox that multiplication need not produce effective strength.
A mutually supporting host is the collective whose efficacy can diverge from its size.
Public gathering supplies the visible concentration that can be mistaken for support.
Material density and abundance supply a second image of accumulation without guaranteed power.

changed_reading.before: Weaker troops simply means a smaller or less powerful group.
changed_reading.after: Even a multiplied, densely assembled host may be weaker as support; the phrase can distinguish accumulated quantity from usable collective force.

strongest_changes: Extension became a bounded approach ending in forced disclosure rather than neutral postponement.
The closing comparison became a direct audit of the preceding claims to station, assembly, possessions, and appearance.
The following increase in guidance recast extension in misguidance as the adverse side of directional continuation.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah compresses time, perception, social rank, and collective efficacy into one reversal: allowance extends a trajectory until the event itself supplies the metric that visible status could not.
remaining_uncertainties: The extension may actively amplify misguidance or merely permit its internally repeated causes to continue.
The status comparison may directly answer 19:73-74 or participate in a broader judgment scene.
Counted promise and multiplied weakness are packet-licensed exploratory overlays, not lexical substitutions.

baseline.text: De ki: Kim sapkınlık içindeyse Rahman ona uzun bir süre versin. Sonunda kendilerine vaat edileni, ya azabı ya kıyamet saatini gördüklerinde, kimin yerinin daha kötü ve ordusunun daha güçsüz olduğunu bilecekler.

findings.text: Sapkınlık içindeki sürenin uzaması onay değil, görünen güç ve konumun zayıflığının belirlenmiş sonda açığa çıkmasına tanınan ölçülü fırsattır.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Nearly repeats the focus's sequence: seeing what was promised reveals whose supporters and number are weaker.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: A hostile crowd calls Shuayb weak in a historical dispute, without the focus's eschatological reversal.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Satan's deceptive promises illuminate the contrast with the true promise whose reality the misguided will see.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its unrelated command to extend a rope shares wording but does not develop reprieve, punishment, or the Hour.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Immediately precedes the focus: unbelievers boast of the better station and gathering that the focus overturns.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Affirms that God's promise through His messengers is not broken, supporting certainty of the promised final outcome.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Those led astray see the punishment, conceal remorse, and receive recompense, directly anticipating the focus's exposure.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The command for Moses to travel by night does not clarify misguidance, reprieve, or the promised final event.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Shows misguiding others ultimately harms the misleaders themselves, a related consequence of misguidance.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Uses the same announcement that people will know who is in clear misguidance, directly paralleling the focus's final disclosure.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Immediately before the focus, it recalls communities with superior possessions and appearance who were destroyed.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Extended wealth offers a limited worldly parallel to the focus's extended reprieve in misguidance.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Directly joins delayed punishment, seeing what was promised, and the eventual destruction of the defiantly wicked.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: An army's drowning supplies a historical image of organized forces proving powerless before divine judgment.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The extended pillars of Hell punishment share only the idea of extension, not the focus's argument.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Explicitly calls condemned people worse in position and more astray, closely echoing the focus's reversal of status.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The immediate continuation contrasts God's increase of the guided with the better reward and return of lasting good deeds.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The account of mighty armies gives only a broad context for the focus's claim about weaker forces.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Same-surah continuation: a denier is granted an extension of punishment, sharpening the focus's extended reprieve.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The numbered guardians of the Fire relate to the focus's reference to forces, within a punishment setting.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: God sends unseen forces and punishes unbelievers, a related contrast to reliance on merely apparent troops.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The misguided see the punishment and seek a way back, directly matching the focus's moment of realization.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Inevitable death and return to the Knower culminate in disclosure of deeds, a broad final-account counterpart.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Identifies idols as a source of widespread misguidance, clarifying the state named in the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The prayer explicitly asks to be shown what the deniers are promised, closely matching the focus's seeing motif.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The Friday-prayer instruction has no material relation to the focus's eschatological warning.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Declares both seeker and sought weak, supporting the focus's exposure of supposedly supporting powers as weak.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Directly explains the Hour's certain but divinely timed arrival, one of the two promised outcomes in the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: God alone knows His forces and appoints the Fire's guardians, contextualizing the focus's comparison of forces.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Joseph's brothers call their father misguided while claiming group strength, a limited ironic parallel to false judgment.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Sets guidance against those upon whom misguidance became due and directs attention to the deniers' outcome.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: People emerge so their deeds may be shown to them, a general counterpart to seeing the consequences promised.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Records the deniers' dismissal of what they are promised, directly contrasting their later unavoidable realization.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Those driven to Hell are explicitly worse in place and more astray in way, closely matching both focus verdicts.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: Seeing trade and amusement concerns abandoning the sermon, not the promised punishment or Hour.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: God's hosts in heaven and earth provide a theological contrast to the allegedly strong human forces in the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Joseph's statement that his brothers are worse in position supplies a moral, non-eschatological status reversal.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The defeat of the Elephant army is a distant historical example of troops failing before divine action.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Names those disputing the Hour as far astray while believers know it is true, directly supporting the focus's contrast.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Describes choosing misguidance over guidance and punishment over forgiveness, directly linking misguidance to the Fire.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Failure to carry the Torah and God's not guiding wrongdoers only broadly relate to being left in misguidance.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The gathered forces of Iblis offer a related image of organized false support, though without the focus's final verdict.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Wrongdoers see the punishment, hide regret, and are judged with justice, closely paralleling the focus's event.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Challenges the unbelievers' supposed army that could aid them against the Most Merciful, directly echoing weak forces.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Those in the Fire call for doubled punishment for those who led them there, extending the focus's punishment theme.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Commands leaving deniers to play until they meet their promised day, directly paralleling the focus's delayed reprieve.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: God extends the hypocrites in their transgression as they wander blindly, closely matching extension in misguidance.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Commands leaving deniers in diversion until they meet their promised day, directly parallel to the focus's sequence.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: God's hosts belong to Him, providing a broader contrast to the focus's inadequate human troops.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: Idris being raised to a high place does not clarify the focus's threat or reversal of worldly standing.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: God's own forces are victorious, supplying a direct theological contrast to the focus's weak opposing forces.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Sets the human response as grateful or ungrateful after guidance, a limited counterpart to the focus's two outcomes.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P4 (19:59-76) - Social Value Reversed Across Time
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Visible status is appraised against outcomes that unfold beyond the immediate display.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Household furniture, market valuation, military support, tied generations, wasteland, and returning payment form one temporal appraisal system.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Furnished assembly, priced station, and weak support
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Rival groups display furnishings, appearance, meeting place, and supporters as evidence of superior rank.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: abundant household furnishings (`quranic:root_000010:B002/m01`); visible appearance or reflected presentation (`quranic:root_000531:B006/m01`); residence or assembly station (`quranic:root_001273:B006/m01`); valuation and pricing (`quranic:root_001273:B010/m01`); council or social gathering (`quranic:root_001486:B001/m01`); organized host of supporters (`quranic:root_000264:B001/m01`); lack of force (`quranic:root_000909:B001/m01`); value selected as better (`quranic:root_000452:B002/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Status is staged as a public appraisal of house, body, venue, and entourage. The later disclosure of weak support exposes the pricing error: visible abundance had been treated as security.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalı sesle ortaya çıkarılan söz ve harflerden kurulu sözlü ifade olarak verir. Geçici çerçeve aynı çekirdeği taşıyor; dil organı, hükümdar unvanı ve mecazi yan kullanımlar bu dalın dışında kalır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal çıplak söz söyleme ve söylenmiş söz çekirdeğidir; organ, unvan, söylenti ve mecazlar ayrı dallardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam bare olduğu için tanım çıplak söyleme ve sözlü ifade anlamıyla sınırlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir düşünceyi veya sözü sesli biçimde dışa vurma ve böyle dışa vurulmuş harfli sözlü ifade anlamıdır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek işlem, sözü sesli olarak dışa çıkarmaktır.
Söylenen şey tek söz, cümle, şiir veya konuşma ölçeğinde olabilir.
Ad biçimleri aynı söylenmiş söz alanında toplanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, sözü sesle dışa çıkarılan ve harflerden oluşan sözlü ifade çekirdeğinde toplar; ad biçimleri de aynı alana bağlıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi azlığı çokluğun karşıtı olarak verir; ayrıca yoksulluk, düşüklük, bir şeyi az görme ve belirli yapılarda yokluğa ya da seyrekliğe yaklaşan kullanımları açıkça destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol yalnızca sayı ve miktar azlığını ve buna bağlı kullanımları kapsar; yükseklik, kap, taşıma ve titreme anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Temel azlık anlamı ile yoksullaşma ve az görme gibi türemiş biçimler birlikte bulunur; yokluk ve seyrekleşme anlamları ise yalnızca belirtilen yapılara bağlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin sayı, miktar ya da ölçü bakımından çok olmayışını bildirir. Bundan yoksulluk ve düşüklük, bir şeyi az sayma veya az gösterme ve belirli yapılarda hiçlik ya da seyrek gerçekleşme anlamları gelişir.

facets.statement: Bir varlığın sayı, miktar veya ölçü bakımından çok olmayışıdır.
Azlık, kişinin yoksullaşması veya toplum içinde düşük ve değersiz görülmesi sonucuna uzanabilir.
Bir şeyi gerçekte ya da değerlendiren kişinin gözünde az sayma ve az gösterme anlamını taşır.
Belirli olumsuzluk ve sıklık yapılarında hiç yokluğu veya bir eylemin pek seyrek gerçekleşmesini anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar azlığın temel sayı ve miktar karşıtlığında birleşir; yoksulluk ve düşüklük, az sayma ve bazı yapılarda yokluğa yaklaşan kullanım bu çekirdeğin düzenli uzantılarıdır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: القل القليل؛ رماه الله بالقل والذل أي بالقلة والذلة (jamhara)؛ شيء قليل وجمعه قلل؛ قل الشيء يقل قلة؛ قلله في عينه؛ أقل افتقر؛ استقله عده قليلا (sihah)؛ قل الشيء يقل قلة فهو قليل وقلال؛ القل من الرجال الخسيس الدنيء؛ قليلة ولا كثيرة؛ قليلا ما يؤمنون؛ قاللت لفلان؛ تقاللت ما أعطاني (tahdhib)؛ القلة والكثرة يستعملان في الأعداد؛ يكنى بالقلة عن الذلة؛ يكنى بها تارة عن العزة؛ قليل يعبر به عن النفي (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyin en üstünü veya başını çekirdek anlam olarak verir; dağın yuvarlak üst bölümü, insan başı ve kılıcın başındaki topuz bu çekirdeğin açık uzmanlaşmalarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol uzamsal başı ve en üst parçayı bildirir; sayısal azlık ya da büyük kap anlamını içermez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel baş ve en üst bölüm anlamı ile dağ tepesi, insan başı ve kılıç topuzu gibi yapıya bağlı uzmanlaşmalar ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin başını veya en üst bölümünü bildirir. Dağın üstteki yuvarlak parçası, insan başı ve kılıcın sap ucundaki topuz bu uzamsal çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir nesnenin veya oluşumun başı ya da en üstte bulunan bölümüdür.
Dağın en üstünde yer alan, kimi tanımda yuvarlak biçimli bölümünü adlandırır.
İnsan başı ile kılıcın sap ucundaki başlık veya topuz da aynı üst ve baş kavramıyla adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar bir şeyin başı ve en üst bölümü üzerinde birleşir; dağ tepesi temel örnektir, insan başı ile kılıç topuzu da aynı biçimsel ve uzamsal çizgide yer alır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir nesnenin ya da doğal oluşumun en üst bölümünü ve başını kapsayan genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Baş olma ile uzamsal olarak en üstte bulunma çekirdeğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Dağın en üst ve kimi zaman yuvarlak bölümünün adlandırıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dağa özgü en üst bölüm uzmanlaşmasını doğrudan korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsan başının veya başka bir şeyin baş sayılan üst bölümünün kastedildiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Üst bölümün baş olarak kavranmasını kısa ve doğal biçimde verir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kılıcın sap ucunda bulunan başlık ya da topuz parçası anlatılırken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kılıca özgü baş veya üst parça uzmanlaşmasını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol dağın yuvarlak üst bölümünü ve kılıcın sap ucundaki topuzu da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol başla ilgili renk, büyüklük, yaralanma, sayım ve alışveriş kullanımlarına kadar uzanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da insanın veya başka bir şeyin başını ve en üst bölümünü adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Baş ve üst bölüm çekirdekleri yakındır; bu kol tepe ve topuz biçimini öne çıkarırken komşu kol başı daha geniş varlık ve kullanım alanlarında işler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol insan başını ve kılıç topuzunu da üst veya baş kavramına bağlar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol yüksekliği hörgüç, soy üstünlüğü ve toplumsal onur alanlarına genişletir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da bir şeyin en yüksek, öne çıkan tepe bölümünü anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol somut baş ve üst parça sınırında kalır; komşu kol fiziksel doruktan toplumsal yüceliğe uzanan daha geniş bir yükseklik alanı kurar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol başı, tepeyi ve en üstte bulunan parçayı bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol sayı, miktar veya ölçü bakımından azlığı bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Aynı kökün sesçe yakın iki ayrı anlam kolu olmaları dışında ortak çekirdekleri yoktur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu anlam uzamsal bir üst bölüm adıdır; komşu anlam ise çokluğun karşıtı olan nicelik durumudur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; genel baş anlamı, doruk ve yükseklik alanı ve aynı kökteki azlık anlamıyla biçimsel karışma sınırı en yararlı karşılaştırmalar olarak seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: قُلَّة الجبل وأعلى كل شيء، ورأس الإنسان، وقبيعة السيف
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس القلة بمعنى الصغر أو العدد القليل، وليس إناء القُلَّة
branches.source_phrase_ar: القلة قلة الجبل وهي القطعة تستدير في أعلاه وهي القنة (jamhara)؛ القلة أعلى الجبل؛ قلة كل شيء أعلاه؛ رأس الإنسان قلة (sihah)؛ قلة كل شيء رأسه؛ قلة الجبل أعلاه؛ قبيعة السيف قلته؛ سيف مقلل (tahdhib)؛ قلة الجبل شعفه (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi büyük bir küp veya iri kap anlamında birleşir; iki kaplık ölçü ve belirli bir bölgeyle anılan iri küpler de aynı kap anlamını somutlaştırır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol büyük bir kap türünü ve onun ölçü değerini kapsar; nicelik azlığı veya dağ tepesi anlamını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Büyük küp anlamı çekirdektir; belirli bir bölgeye bağlanan kap adı ile iki kaplık ölçü yalnızca kendi yapılardaki uzmanlaşmalardır.

concept_map.definition: Büyük bir küpü veya küpe benzeyen iri kabı bildirir. Belirli bir bölgenin iri küpleri ve iki böyle kabın aldığı miktar bu kap anlamına bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Küpe benzeyen, özellikle sıvı taşımaya veya saklamaya elverişli büyük bir kaptır.
Belirli bir bölgeyle anılan iri küpler veya büyük toprak kaplar bu adın tanınmış bir türünü oluşturur.
İki büyük kap, bu iki kabın kendisini veya onların aldığı sıvı miktarını bildiren bir ölçü değeri kazanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar iri bir küp veya büyük kap üzerinde birleşir; tanınmış bölgesel kaplar büyüklüğü örnekler, iki kaplık kullanım ise nesne adını kapasite ölçüsüne taşır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Küpe benzeyen iri kabı adlandıran temel ve en doğal Türkçe karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Kabın küp türünde ve olağandan büyük oluşunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kabın özellikle su alması ve büyük kapasitesi öne çıkarıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Büyük kabı ve kaynakta belirtilen su taşıma kapasitesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İki kabın kendisinden çok onların aldığı sıvı miktarı ölçü olarak kastedildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İki büyük kabın kapasitesine dayanan ölçü kullanımını tam olarak korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: iki büyük küp veya bunların aldığı miktar

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol iri küpün yanı sıra küpün yerleştirildiği tahta destekleri de kapsayabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da çok büyük bir küpü veya fıçımsı saklama kabını adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Kap nesnesinde güçlü bir örtüşme vardır; bu kol ölçü değerine uzanırken komşu kol kabın yerleştirildiği desteği de kapsayan farklı bir sınır kurar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol kabın özellikle iri oluşunu ve iki kaplık ölçü değerini belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol genel bir küp veya saklama kabını büyüklük koşulu olmadan adlandırabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da küp biçimindeki büyükçe saklama kapları için kullanılabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kolda büyük kapasite kurucu bir özelliktir; komşu kartta kap türü öndedir ve aynı ölçü uzantısı bulunmaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol büyük bir küpü ve ona dayalı kapasite ölçüsünü bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol bir şeyin başını, tepesini veya en üst bölümünü bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Aynı kökün sesçe yakın iki ayrı anlam kolu olmaları dışında ortak çekirdekleri yoktur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Biri hacimli bir kap ve onun ölçüsüdür; diğeri bir varlığın uzamsal olarak en üstteki parçasıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; büyük küp anlamına en yakın iki kap komşusu ile aynı kökteki tepe anlamından ayrım, sınırı göstermek için yeterli ve yinelenmeyen karşılaştırmalardır.
branches.what_is_ar: القُلَّة إناء كالجرة الكبيرة، ومنها قلال هجر والحباب العظام
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس قلة العدد، وليس رأس الجبل
branches.source_phrase_ar: القلة التي جاءت في الحديث مثل قلال هجر هي جرار عظام (jamhara)؛ القلة إناء للعرب كالجرة الكبيرة؛ قلال هجر شبيهة بالحباب (sihah)؛ قلتين يعني هذه الحباب العظام واحدتها قلة؛ قلال هجر؛ القلة منها تأخذ مزادة من الماء (tahdhib)؛ القلة ما أقله الإنسان من جرة وحب (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yükü taşıma veya taşıyabilme ile öznenin yükselip harekete geçmesini aynı kolda açıkça toplar; kuşun uçuşa kalkması, göğün yükselmesi ve yolcuların yüklenip ayrılması ayrı katılımcı gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Taşıma, yükselme ve yüklenerek yola koyulma bu kolun sınırıdır; salt sayısal azlık bu anlamlara katılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yük taşıma ile yükselme çekirdek çizgileri ayrılır; ağır bulut taşıma, uçuşa kalkma ve yolcuların ayrılması yalnızca kendi özne ve yapılarında geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Bir yükü kaldırıp taşıyabilmeyi veya üstlenmeyi ve bir öznenin yükselerek harekete geçmesini bildirir. İkinci çizgi kuşun uçuşa kalkmasını, göğün yükselmesini ve yolcuların yüklenip yola koyulmasını kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi kaldıracak gücü bulmak, onu taşımak veya yük olarak üstlenmektir.
Bir öznenin aşağıdaki konumundan yükselmesi veya kuş gibi harekete ve uçuşa başlamasıdır.
Yolcuların yüklerini alıp bulundukları yerden ayrılarak yolculuğa başlamasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar bir yükü kaldırıp taşıma ile yukarı kalkarak harekete geçme çizgilerini bir araya getirir; kuş, gök, bulut ve yolcu örnekleri katılımcıya göre bu iki çizgiyi somutlaştırır.

concept_gloss.text: yük kaldırma, yükselme ve yola koyulma
concept_gloss.applicability: Taşıma, yukarı kalkma ve yüklenerek hareket etme çizgilerinin birlikte özetlenmesi gereken kavram haritasında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yük üstlenme, yükselme ve yolculuk için harekete geçme bileşenlerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin veya başka bir taşıyıcının bir nesnenin ağırlığını üstlenmesi bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yükü kaldırma gücü ile onu fiilen taşıma anlamlarını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Göğün yükselmesi veya kuşun uçuşa kalkması gibi yukarı yönlü hareket bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yukarı kalkma ile uçuş için yerden ayrılma değerlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir topluluğun yolculuk yüklerini alarak bulunduğu yerden ayrılması bağlamına özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Yük alma, ayrılma ve yolculuğa başlama aşamalarını birlikte korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol yükü taşıma eyleminden çok onu taşıyacak güce sahip olmayı öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da bir yükün ağırlığını karşılayacak gücü ve taşıma yeterliğini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Taşıma yeterliği ortak olsa da bu kol fiilî taşıma ve yerden yükselme yönlerine açılır; komşu kol güç yetirme sınırında kalır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol yük üstlenmeyi, kuşun havalanmasını ve yolcuların yüklenerek ayrılmasını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol kişinin oturduğu yerden kalkmasını ve bir nesneyi bulunduğu yerden kaldırmayı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da aşağıdaki veya durağan bir konumdan kalkma ve hareket başlangıcını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol yükselmeyi taşıma ve yolculukla bağlar; komşu kol bedensel olarak ayağa kalkma ve nesneyi yerinden kaldırma çevresindedir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kolda yolculuk anlamı yolcuların yüklerini alıp bulundukları yerden ayrılmasıyla sınırlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol yol üzerinde ilerlemeyi ve belirli bir hedefe doğru seyahat etmeyi genel olarak bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da bir yerden ayrılarak yolculuğa başlama durumunda buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol başlangıçtaki yüklenme ve kalkış anını anlatır; komşu kol yolculuğun kendisini ve hedefe doğru ilerlemeyi çekirdek edinir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar karşılaştırıldı; taşıma gücü, yerden kalkma ve yolculuğa başlama komşuları bu kolun üç kurucu yönünü en az yinelemeyle açıklar.

branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس مجرد القلة العددية، ولا قلة الجبل، ولا الرعدة
branches.source_phrase_ar: أقل الجرة أطاق حملها؛ استقلت السماء ارتفعت؛ استقل القوم مضوا وارتحلوا (sihah)؛ أقل الرجل الشيء واستقله إذا احتمله؛ استقل الطائر إذا نهض للطيران؛ استقل النبات أناف؛ استقل القوم إذا احتملوا ظاعنين؛ أقلت سحابا ثقالا أي حملت؛ قل إذا رفع وقل إذا علا (tahdhib)؛ أقلت سحابا ثقالا أي احتملته؛ أقللت كذا وجدته قليل المحمل (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kişiyi korku veya öfke yüzünden tutan titreme ve silkinişi açıkça tanımlar; genel hareket kararsızlığı değil, duygusal tetikleyicisi bulunan bedensel bir sarsıntı söz konusudur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol insanda korku veya öfkeyle beliren titremeyle sınırlıdır; nesnelerin genel sallanma ve yerinde duramama hali ayrı koldadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Duygudan doğan titreme temel addır; kişiyi titremenin tutması ve öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi yalnızca ilgili yapılara bağlı anlatımlardır.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın korku veya öfke yüzünden titremesi, ürpermesi ya da bedensel olarak silkelenmesidir. Durum, kişiyi bir titreme nöbetinin tutması veya öfkenin titremeyle dışa vurulması biçiminde anlatılabilir.

facets.statement: İnsan bedeninde beliren titreme, ürperti veya istemsiz silkiniş halidir.
Titremenin belirleyici nedeni korku ya da öfkedir.
Belirli yapılarda titremenin kişiyi tutması veya kişinin öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar insandaki titreme ve silkinişte birleşir; korku ile öfke başlıca nedenlerdir ve durum hem kişiyi tutan bir nöbet hem öfkenin bedensel belirtisi olarak anlatılır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Duygusal nedeni ve bedensel titremeyi birlikte taşıyan bütün kol için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Korku veya öfke koşulunu ve bunun doğurduğu bedensel titremeyi birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Korkunun yol açtığı kısa ve istemsiz bedensel titreme bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Korkuya bağlı istemsiz titreme ve silkiniş hissini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Titremenin kişiyi birden tutan belirgin bir durum olarak anlatıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Titremenin kişiyi tutan bedensel bir olay olarak sunuluşunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Öfkenin bedensel titreme halinde dışa vurulduğu kişi bağlamlarına özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Öfke nedenini ve onunla birlikte ortaya çıkan titremeyi korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol insandaki titreme veya silkinişi belirli bir duygusal nedenle sınırlamaz.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da insan bedeninde ortaya çıkan titreme veya silkinişi adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bedensel olay aynıdır; bu kol korku ve öfke koşulunu taşırken komşu kart neden bakımından daha genel kalır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol korkunun yanında öfkeyi de titremenin belirleyici nedeni olarak içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol hastalık, gevşeklik, yumuşaklık ve korkaklıkla ilişkili titremeleri de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da özellikle korku sırasında insanda görülen titreme ve ürpermede örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Korkuya bağlı kullanımda yakınlaşırlar; bu kol öfkeyi ekler, komşu kol ise hastalık ve bedensel gevşeklik gibi başka nedenlere açılır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; genel insan titremesi ve nedenleri daha geniş ürperme alanı, bu kolun kişi ve duygu sınırını en iyi gösterir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyi hareket ettirip sallandırma, nesnenin bulunduğu yerde kararlı duramaması ve hareketin çıkardığı sesi birlikte verir; bunlar tek bir fiziksel hareket olayının neden, sonuç ve işitsel yönleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol genel fiziksel oynama, kararsızlık ve hareket sesiyle ilgilidir; korku veya öfkeden doğan insana özgü titreme değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak kolun hareket ettirme, sallanma, yerinde duramama ve hareket sesi anlamlarını kapsar; özel bir yapının anlamı genelleştirilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi hareket ettirerek yerinden oynatmayı ve onun kararsızca sallanıp bulunduğu yerde duramamasını bildirir; bu hareketin çıkardığı ses de aynı olayın işitsel yönüdür.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi hareket ettirip onun yerinden oynamasına ve sarsılmasına neden olmaktır.
Nesnenin bulunduğu yerde sabit kalmayıp sallanması, oynaması veya düzensiz hareket etmesidir.
Sallanma ve yer değiştirme sırasında çıkan ses, hareket olayının işitsel belirtisi olarak adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar dışarıdan hareket ettirme ile nesnenin kararsızca sallanıp yerinde duramaması üzerinde birleşir; hareketin sesi bu fiziksel olayın ayrılmaz işitsel belirtisi olarak eklenir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı, bir şeyin gerçekleşip bulunur hale gelmesini çekirdek kabul eder ve buna olma adları ile geçmiş ya da şimdiki bildirme kullanımlarını bağlar. Pekiştirme, ayırma ve ettirgen oluşturma kullanımları aynı dal içinde bağımlı kullanımlar olarak durur; yer, konum ve üstlenme dalları bu çekirdeğin yerine geçirilmez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, gerçekleşme ve bulunma çekirdeğiyle sınırlıdır; yer, konum, üstlenme ve boyun eğme ayrı dallardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam hem yalın hem bağlı kullanımlar verdiği için tanım çekirdeği ayrı, bağlı sözleri ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bu dal, bir şeyin gerçekleşip bulunur hale gelmesini ve bu olmanın geçmiş ya da şimdiki anda bildirilmesini anlatır. Olma adları, pekiştirme ya da ayırma işlevli bağlı sözler ve bir şeyi oldurup oluşmasını sağlama buna bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin gerçekleşmesi, ortaya çıkması ve bulunur halde olması çekirdektir.
Olma ve oluş adları bu çekirdeğin adlaştırılmış biçimleridir.
Geçmişteki bir durumun haber verilmesi veya şimdiki olmanın bildirilmesi bu alana bağlıdır.
Pekiştirme ve gelen kişiyi kapsam dışı bırakma gibi bağlı söz dizimleri çekirdeğe ek kullanımlardır.
Bir şeyi oldurmak, onun gerçekleşmesini sağlama yönünde ettirgen bir uzantıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, dalı bir şeyin olması, gerçekleşmesi ve hazır bulunması etrafında toplar. Aynı bildirim içinde olma adları, geçmiş ya da şimdiki haber verme, pekiştirme, ayırma ve ettirgen oldurma kullanımları da bu çekirdeğe bağlanır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, hareketli bir şeyin sahibinden gitmesini ve sabit bir yerin konumuna ulaşamamayı aynı bulamama alanında toplar. Kanın öçsüz kalması ise kaybın sahiplik değil karşılık ve talep bakımından kurulduğu özel, kalıba bağlı bir uzantıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin sahibinin elinden çıkması veya kişinin hareketli bir şeyi ya da sabit bir yerin konumunu bulamamasıdır. Özel bir kullanımda öldürülen kişinin kanı öç alınmadan ve karşılık aranmadan kalır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin sahibinden gitmesi ve nerede olduğunun bilinememesi temel yitirme ilişkisidir.
Ev, ibadet yeri veya başka sabit bir yerin konumuna ulaşamamak, nesneyi değil yolu bulamama biçimidir.
Bir işin elden kaçması ve ona erişecek yolun bulunamaması, yitirme ilişkisinin soyut uzantısıdır.
Öldürülen kişinin kanının öç alınmadan kalması, kaybı karşılıksız kalma sonucuna bağlayan özel kullanımdır.
